heading: The Marginarium: a storybook
first_line: Seven chapters in the Marginarium tell, in plain words, how this app was made by Paul and his team of AI agents.
content_why: One passage and one picture per chapter reads like a picture book, and the full stories can wait for the app, which keeps the README short.
avoid: Do not claim the in-app Marginarium exists yet, because it is not built.
